text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain one one thousand and the pilot monitoring called one two thousand for Alaska four two one. The crew set MCP 11000 and climbs and the panel showed MCP altitude 11000 while the aircraft moved from altitude 8989 to altitude 11232. Crosscheck said "Readback one-two thousand, cleared one-one thousand." at 25.6 s.
